title: Agency Profile
description: Single source of truth for the agency operating the system. Captures the agency identity, the named agent(s) who send outreach, the sending mailbox(es) + warmup state, and the signature template baked into every email. v0.1 = single agency, single agent (`agents` and `sending_mailboxes` arrays both length 1). v2 will lift the single-agent constraint to multi-agent (e.g. Sarah handles 5 talents, Tom handles 3) without breaking the v0.1 shape — the array structure is already in place. Lives at `data/agency_profile.json` (gitignored — contains real agent contact details).

agency_id.description: Stable slug identifier for the agency. Used as the root identifier when v2 introduces multi-agency.

name.description: Display name of the agency, used in email signatures + intros.

domain.description: The agency's primary domain (e.g. `nativeagency.com`). All sending mailboxes are subdomains/addresses of this domain. SPF/DKIM/DMARC records live here.

branding.description: Visual brand identity captured at agency-setup time (Phase 0 Step 1.5). Used by downstream artefact generators — discovery-call prep decks (Phase 4.5), proposal decks (Phase 4 PROPOSAL), case-study leave-behinds, and any other agency-branded output. Single source of truth: every generated document picks up these values, so a rebrand in this block propagates everywhere on next render.

logo_url.description: Primary logo. Web-accessible URL or local path. Used in HTML signatures + on cover slides + footers. Recommend 500-1000px wide PNG with transparent background.

logo_dark_url.description: Optional. Logo variant for dark backgrounds. If absent, the renderer falls back to logo_url.

primary_color.description: Hex color for primary brand surfaces — slide titles, headings, accent shapes. Format `#RRGGBB`.

secondary_color.description: Hex color for secondary surfaces — subtitles, dividers, secondary buttons.

accent_color.description: Optional accent for callouts, highlighted KPI numbers, etc.

background_color.description: Default slide background. Most decks stay white but agencies with darker brand identities may override.

text_color.description: Default body text color. Must have sufficient contrast against background_color.

font_family_heading.description: CSS font-family stack for headings (e.g. `"Inter", sans-serif`). Renderer must ensure the font is web-loadable or fall back to safe defaults.

font_family_body.description: CSS font-family stack for body text.

google_fonts.description: Optional list of Google Font family names to load (e.g. ["Inter", "Playfair Display"]). Renderer injects the corresponding <link> tags.

tagline.description: Short positioning line used on title slides + signature footers (e.g. `Talent representation that works.`).

deck_template_id.description: Identifier for the deck visual template the renderer should use. v0.1: `default`. v2: agencies can register custom templates and select per-context (e.g. `editorial`, `bold`, `minimal`).

agents.description: v0.1: exactly one agent (constraint enforced via maxItems: 1). v2: maxItems lifted; multi-agent rosters supported with per-agent talent assignment.

sending_mailboxes.description: Mailboxes the agency sends outreach from. v0.1 typically = 1 (the primary agent's mailbox). Each mailbox is independently warmed up in Smartlead.

company_address.description: Physical mailing address. REQUIRED for CAN-SPAM compliance — every cold email must include the sender's physical address in the footer. Composed into the email signature.

unsubscribe_email.description: Address that handles List-Unsubscribe responses. Typically `unsubscribe@{domain}` or a dedicated inbox. Drives the one-click unsubscribe required by Gmail/Yahoo Feb 2024 rules.

default_signature_template.description: Email signature block. Supports merge fields: `{agent_name}`, `{agent_title}`, `{agent_email}`, `{agent_phone}`, `{agency_name}`, `{agency_website}`, `{agency_address}`, `{unsubscribe_link}`. Required to end every outreach email; the orchestrator validates presence at send-time.

default_voice_mode.description: How the LLM positions agent vs talent in generated emails. v0.1 default per user decision: agent-led on-behalf-of. v2 may add per-talent overrides.

billing_entity.description: The agency's OWN legal entity. Used for outreach signature CAN-SPAM compliance (physical address requirement) + as a fallback FROM party on invoices when `commission_model = agency_invoices_brand_pays_talent_net`. Distinguished from `talent.billing_entity` which is the talent's legal entity. Different concept — agency may or may not be the invoicing party depending on the commission model.

default_commission_rate.description: Agency-default commission rate as decimal (0.20 = 20%). Applied to every talent unless overridden via `talent.commission_override.commission_rate`. Powers Phase 4.8 invoice flow — when `commission_model = agency_invoices_brand_pays_talent_net`, agency invoices brand for full fee; talent settlement = fee × (1 - commission_rate).

default_commission_model.description: Agency-default money-flow model. agency_invoices_brand_pays_talent_net (most common): agency is the FROM party on brand-facing invoices; agency receives payment; agency settles talent net of commission. talent_invoices_brand_agency_invoices_talent: talent is FROM party; agency auto-generates a separate commission invoice to talent. talent_invoices_brand_talent_pays_agency: talent FROM party + talent manually settles agency. Per-talent override via `talent.commission_override.commission_model`.

invoice_template.description: Agency-wide invoice template used by the Phase 4.8 invoice pack generator (`docs/invoice_workflow.md`). Captured in Phase 0 agency setup. One template for all talent + deals; talent-specific billing entity is pulled from `talent.billing_entity` at generation time. Invoices are highly deterministic so this template is mostly merge fields + a payment-instructions block — far fewer placeholders than the per-talent contract template.

markdown_source.description: Invoice template body in markdown. Supports `{{merge_field}}` substitution. Optional `{{narrative_line_items}}` placeholder enables LLM-drafted per-line-item descriptions; absent = literal deliverable descriptions used. Renders to PDF via Puppeteer/pandoc.

invoice_number_prefix.description: String prefix on every invoice number. e.g. 'INV-' produces INV-2026-0001.

invoice_number_format.description: Format string for invoice numbers. Tokens: `{prefix}`, `{YYYY}`, `{YY}`, `{MM}`, `{seq:0Nd}` (zero-padded sequence). Default produces INV-2026-0042 style.

invoice_number_sequence.description: Auto-incrementing per-agency sequence counter. Persisted on the agency_profile — generator reads + increments atomically on each new invoice. Per-agency (not per-talent or per-deal) so numbering is contiguous across the whole agency.

default_payment_terms_days.description: Default days from sent_at to due_at. Per-invoice can override (e.g. NET-15, NET-45 deals).

tax_handling.description: none: no tax line. vat_inclusive: total already includes VAT (rendered as 'inclusive of VAT'). vat_added: subtotal + tax_amount = total (UK/EU pattern). sales_tax: same math as vat_added with sales tax labelling (US pattern).

default_tax_rate.description: Decimal default tax rate (0.20 = 20%). Applied when tax_handling is vat_added / vat_inclusive / sales_tax. Per-invoice override available.

tax_label.description: Label on the rendered tax line (e.g. 'VAT', 'Sales Tax', 'GST'). Derived from tax_handling but overridable for unusual cases.

payment_instructions_markdown.description: Block rendered into the invoice footer. Bank details / IBAN / SWIFT / Stripe payment link / PayPal address. Supports merge fields for per-invoice substitution (e.g. `{{invoice_number}}` as bank reference).

invoice_footer.description: Legal text appended to the invoice (e.g. 'Late payment subject to 8% statutory interest per the Late Payment of Commercial Debts (Interest) Act 1998.'). Optional.

template_version.description: Updated whenever markdown_source / numbering / tax settings change. Captured in `invoice_pack.context_snapshot.agency_invoice_template_version` for traceability.

agent_id.description: Stable slug identifier for the agent.

name.description: Agent's full name as it appears in the FROM line + signature.

email.description: Agent's primary inbox. Replies route here. May or may not equal the sending mailbox (agencies sometimes send from `sarah@` and receive at `partnerships@`).

title.description: Job title for the signature (e.g. 'Director of Brand Partnerships').

is_primary.description: True for the agent who acts as the default sender when an explicit per-talent agent isn't assigned. v0.1: must be true (only one agent). v2: exactly one agent must be primary.

represents_talent_ids.description: v0.1: agent represents all talents (this array may be empty as a 'represents everyone' signal, or contain all talent_ids). v2: explicit assignment enables agent-to-talent routing — each talent's outreach uses their assigned agent's mailbox + signature.

email.description: The address emails are sent FROM. Must be on the agency's domain.

agent_id.description: FK to `agents[].agent_id`. The agent this mailbox represents.

purpose.description: named_agent_outreach: `sarah@agency.com` style, brand sees the agent's name on the FROM line — v0.1 default per user decision. generic_agency_outreach: `partnerships@agency.com` — used in v2 as fallback. transactional: agency's reply-handling inbox, not for outbound.

warmup_status.description: Lifecycle: pending = DNS not yet verified; in_progress = Smartlead warmup running (typically 2-4 weeks); complete = ready for cold outreach; paused = manually held.

dns_records_verified.description: True when SPF + DKIM + DMARC records are all confirmed for the agency's domain. Gating condition before warmup can start.

smartlead_mailbox_id.description: Identifier in Smartlead's mailbox registry. Set after Smartlead onboards the mailbox.

daily_send_cap.description: Maximum cold emails this mailbox sends per day. Ramps up during warmup; typically caps at 100-200/day for sustainable deliverability.
